IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing-metering-service — token-count drift detected. Overages rising, +18% vs baseline window. Severity P2. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/7200001234
Sam: I'm the on-call SRE, reading the same. @Li @Devin fyi. Tailing emitter logs now.
Li: On it. Quick check shows two emit batches with same batch_id at 03:12:44. Possible retry duplication from proxy.
Olivia: CS just flagged 3 customers who got overage emails (acct: acme, beta-inc, gamma). I'm waiting on confirmation.
Noah: Noted. If it's transient, I'll hold customer comms until we confirm scope.
Devin: Repro command: ```kafkacat -C -b kafka.prod:9092 -t metering-emits -s value -o 0 -c 50 | jq .batch_id``` shows duplicates for batch_ids: ["b-321","b-321"]
Maya: Rollback plan: restore emitter job to v1.12, pause alerting rule `billing_overage_alerts` for 5m, and trigger dedupe backfill. @Li please create a manual filter to drop duplicated batch_ids.
Li: Creating filter now. Patch: ```UPDATE emitter SET dedupe=true WHERE source='proxy-retry'``` - testing on staging, will roll to prod in 2 mins.
Sam: I'm isolating proxy group 'proxy-eu-2' suspected of sending retries behind a rate-limiter misconfig. Scaling down that group to 0. :wrench:
Devin: Applying hotfix to emitter config: `max_retries=3 -> 1` and `idempotency=true` — deploying to canary 10%.
IncidentBot: Escalation scheduled: ENG-BILLING in 10 minutes if counts don't normalize.
Olivia: CS: acme confirmed 8 overage emails, turned off notifications on our side. Beta-inc and gamma are investigating.
Noah: Keep me posted; if >10 customers, we'll prepare template comms. :memo:
Maya: Metrics: token_count_delta now down to +5% after canary deploy. Still watching. Starting dedupe backfill job (job id jb-7201).
Li: Backfill job jb-7201 started. Estimated runtime 12m. Will reconcile counts and emit corrections.
Sam: I've left detailed notes in the incident channel. Handoff in 30m to Arjun for overnight watch. @Arjun you'll get the runbook and the backfill job status.
Arjun: Acknowledged, I'll take over at handoff and monitor the backfill + customer flags.
Maya: Summary actions: rollback emitter -> done; pause alerts -> done; dedupe filter -> applied; backfill -> running. Next: verify reconciliation output, re-enable alerts after we confirm no residual spike.
IncidentBot: Incident status changed to 'mitigating'. Pager cleared for now.
Olivia: CS will wait for reconciliation before sending outbound comms. :white_check_mark:
Noah: Thanks team — excellent quick mitigation. Keep thread updated with reconciliation results.
Maya: Logging final note: follow-up ticket created ENG-4238 for long-term fix (idempotent emitter + improved metrics locks).
